_comment: Maintained dependencies Console selects directly or through its one source replacement.
kind=module_tag: a SemVer tag served by the Go proxy, optionally accompanied by a published source-only GitHub release with no binary assets.
kind=calendar_release: an immutable published RELEASE.* GitHub release with assets; go.mod pins its pseudo-version because the tag is not SemVer.
kind=source_commit: an immutable MC pseudo-version accepted on main with successful Go, Crosscompile, VulnCheck and Test Release Pipeline push runs; no MC release tag or binaries are created.
release_pending=true records a tag the maintainer has not created yet: `make verifiers` warns and the tag preflight fails.
